---
title: "Work map"
---

Where live work meets: which epics, tickets and branches are changing which component of OpenGWASDB, and whether a blocking edge between the specific tickets coordinates the places they meet.

**This page is generated at render time** by
[`src/project_site/architecture_pages.py`](../src/project_site/architecture_pages.py)
from the work collector's data (`work.json`, which combines the board, both
repositories' claims and their pushed branches); the render replaces this file. Run
`pixi run site-data` and then `pixi run site` to see it. Agents read the same data
with `pixi run architecture conflicts`.
